faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before ordering.

items.q: How do I place an order online?
items.a: Go to our Menu page, add your dishes to the cart, then follow the checkout steps. You'll receive a confirmation email with your order number.

items.q: Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
items.a: Call us quickly at (506) 532-0820. If preparation hasn't started yet, we'll do our best to accommodate the change.
You can order online during our opening hours: Tuesday to Sunday, 11:30 AM to 8:00 PM.
Yes! We deliver to Shediac, Cap-Pelé, Pointe-du-Chêne and surrounding areas. Zones and fees are shown at checkout. Pickup at the restaurant is also available.
Generally 30 to 45 minutes depending on your distance and how busy we are.

items.q: Is there a minimum order for delivery?
items.a: The minimum order amount for delivery is shown on the order page and varies by delivery zone.

items.q: How do I report a food allergy?
items.a: At checkout there is a field for allergies or intolerances. The information goes straight to the kitchen.
Some dishes do (soy sauce, breading, etc.). We offer gluten-free options — feel free to contact us.
Absolutely. Our fish is delivered fresh daily and every dish is prepared to order.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Online: credit and debit cards via Stripe (Visa, Mastercard, Amex). In restaurant: cash and Interac.
Yes, all payments are processed by Stripe. Your banking information is never stored on our servers.
If there's a problem with your order, contact us within 24 hours and we'll review your request.

about.title: About
about.heading: The art of sushi, the passion of Korea
about.intro: Discover the story behind every dish we lovingly prepare in Shediac.
about.story: TLJ Sushi & Korean was born from a deep passion for authentic Asian cuisine. Located in Shediac, in the heart of New Brunswick, we offer a unique culinary experience blending the delicate art of Japanese sushi with the bold flavours of Korean cuisine. Our chef combines traditional techniques with fresh ingredients, carefully selected every day. Every dish is prepared to order.

values.d: Every dish is carefully prepared in our kitchen, with no shortcuts or compromises.
Fresh fish delivered daily, seasonal vegetables and quality products.
Your order ready in 15 to 30 minutes, for takeout or delivery.
A passionate team that greets you with a smile, every visit.
